en: Black‑and‑white postcard showing an outdoor terrace of a modernist holiday hotel complex in a wooded mountain setting. Numerous people sit at round tables with striped metal chairs under globe lamps, while the multi‑storey building with stone and concrete facades curves along the hillside in the background. The reverse side has multilingual printed captions identifying the location and function of the site, with standard postcard layout for address and stamp.
